rag.text:
Test: TC-4565 — Box Module - Resources - Resource Grid - Memberships availability is automatically changed to 0 when the user is set as archived
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-471 Box Module - Resources - New Resource Grid
Labels: be-enterprise

Steps:
1. Navigate to Resources module of a boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-4739  Box Module - Resources - Resource Grid - Memberships availability is automatically changed to 0 when the user is set as archived
   Expected: Resources module is displayed

Timeline starts at 01/June/2024

Following users are displayed:

* TC-4739A
* TC-4739B

Task 1 is assigned to user TC-4739A
2. Click on Weekly dropdown menu button and select newAggregation
   Data: newAggregation: Daily
   Expected: Daily aggregation is selected
3. Navigate to Administration -> Resources -> Individuals and click on three dots next to Full name column, type userName and select
   Data: userName: TC-4739A
   Expected: User TC-4739A is selected
4. Click on Archive button
   Expected: Following message is displayed: 

'After archiving, this resource's capacity will be zero, and team’s availability will be set as Unavailable from the archive date. You can restore it anytime, but team availability must be manually adjusted'

Archive and Cancel button is displayed
5. Click Archive
   Expected: Resource TC-4739A is archived
6. Click on three dots next to Archived column and select Archived
   Expected: Both Empty value and Archived options are selected
7. Go back to Resources module of a boxName and click Today on timeline
   Data: boxName: TC-4739  Box Module - Resources - Resource Grid - Memberships availability is automatically changed to 0 when the user is set as archived
   Expected: Resources module is displayed

User TC-4739A dissapears
8. Click the filter panel on the left header menu. Expand the Individuals section and uncheck the Hide archived individuals option
   Expected: User TC-4739A appears with 'Archived' label
9. Hover over Archived label
   Expected: Tooltip 'Since archivization date (current date) this resource capacity is set to zero' is displayed
10. Click on capacity lozenge of date of userName
   Data: userName: TC-4739A

date: Today's date
   Expected: Capacity details dialog is displayed

'Archived' label is displayed next to userName TC-4739A

Following data is displayed:

'Resource Archived' in cursive in 'Factor' column

'Since (today's date)' in 'Details' column
11. Navigate to Administration -> Resources -> Individuals and click on Restore resource button next to userName
   Data: userName: TC-4739A
   Expected: Following message is displayed 

'After restoration, the resource's capacity will return if a resource is not assigned to any team. Teams availability will remain Unavailable, and you can manually adjust it in the Teams module.'

Restore and Cancel button is displayed
12. Click on Restore button
   Expected: Resource TC-4739A is restored
13. Navigate back to Resources module of a boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-4739  Box Module - Resources - Resource Grid - Memberships availability is automatically changed to 0 when the user is set as archived
   Expected: Resource module is displayed
14. Click on Calendar and set newStartDate of timeline
   Data: newStartDate: 01/Jun/24
   Expected: Timeline is changed to 01/Jun/24
15. Click on capacity lozenge of userName date
   Data: userName: TC-4739A

date: 14/Jun/2024
   Expected: Team membership is 100%
